data.title: flutter_devops
data.highlight: Published on pub.dev — an enterprise DevOps toolkit for Flutter teams.
data.description: A Dart command line toolkit that automates Flutter delivery: CI/CD pipeline generation, multi-flavour environment management, Clean Architecture audits, dependency auditing and signed release automation across all six Flutter targets.

data.title: file_anchor
data.category: Open Source · Flutter Plugin · File System
data.highlight: 8 federated packages on pub.dev — pick a file or folder once, access it anywhere.
data.description: A federated Flutter plugin that turns a user-selected location into a durable, opaque anchor token. Native implementations for Android (Storage Access Framework), iOS and macOS (security-scoped bookmarks), Windows (IFileOpenDialog, zero C++) and Linux (XDG desktop portal), with typed failures for stale, revoked and unavailable anchors.

data.title: 24Ryde User App
data.highlight: A Flutter-based rider application for the 24Ryde open-source mobility platform.
data.description: The user-facing ride-hailing application that enables riders to discover rides, manage trips, interact with maps and experience the 24Ryde mobility ecosystem.

data.title: 24Ryde Driver App
data.highlight: A Flutter-based driver application powering the driver side of the 24Ryde platform.
data.description: The driver-facing application for managing ride requests, navigation, trip status and real-time driver operations within the 24Ryde ecosystem.
